Three approved quotes, word for word from the final release, to post live after each speaker (nothing before 10:00):
1. Ruth Kessler: 'My father grew up in Beatrice and never forgot how far families had to go for help. Our family is proud to help bring this care home.'
2. Gov. Patricia Hartley: 'Every Nebraska child deserves care close to home. This $12 million state investment will keep families together while their kids get well.'
3. Dr. Raymond Ellison: 'Nebraska families wait too long, and travel too far, for psychiatric care for their children. This gift changes that.'
